name: bash-rules
description: Mod that denies Bash used to show file contents (use Read; searching with grep and find stays in Bash), write or edit files (use Write/Edit), smuggle encoded or env-var payloads, or destroy systems, infra and data. Commands the parser is unsure about are sent to Ollama (ollama.com for :cloud models), then to Haiku.

modelStages.title: Model checks
modelStages.description: Send commands the parser is unsure about to Ollama, then the fallback model. Off: parser only, and unsure commands run.

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server for the first model check. Empty skips Ollama.

ollamaModel.title: Ollama model
ollamaModel.description: Model for the first check. A :cloud model sends the command to ollama.com. Empty skips Ollama.

ollamaTimeoutMs.title: Ollama timeout (ms)
ollamaTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Ollama before falling back (at most 9000, the hook's time budget).

confidence.title: Ollama confidence
confidence.description: Below this confidence (0 to 1) the fallback model decides instead.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model alias or id for the second, final check, billed to the session. Empty skips it.
